parts.text: Work only in /tmp/ch26-live-0N7L6h. This is one small bounded coding task. Create exactly one child with agent_id helper and delegate implementing slugify.py with slugify(text) that lowercases and joins whitespace-separated words using hyphens (empty input returns empty string), plus a unittest file covering mixed case, repeated whitespace and empty input. The child must run python3 -m unittest -v and submit its actual result. Do not create further children. As parent use get_sub_agent_status and wait_for_agent_change to monitor helper, then join_agents and get_submission. Independently rerun the tests, write fleet-result.txt containing your measured test outcome, and submit a concise final result beginning CH26_LIVE_COMPLETE. Use the inherited model. Do not browse or install packages.

startup_tools.name: agent_status
startup_tools.description: Report the selected model, last response and session token counts, cache hit rate and derived session USD cost (unknown when prices are unavailable).

startup_tools.name: read_file
startup_tools.description: Read text with one-based inclusive start_line/end_line. Optional max_bytes bounds the read; job reports cap inline output and preserve the full result on disk.

startup_tools.name: list_directory
startup_tools.description: List immediate entries, sorted by name; directories end with /.

startup_tools.name: search_files
startup_tools.description: Search files recursively using a regular expression. context_lines defaults to zero. Output uses grep path:line:text and path-line-context with merged windows.

startup_tools.name: write_file
startup_tools.description: Write text, creating parent directories. Existing files require overwrite:true unless append:true. Append preserves existing content.

startup_tools.name: edit_file
startup_tools.description: Replace one exact, unique old_text anchor with new_text. Zero or multiple matches refuse without changing the file; read and provide a more specific anchor.

startup_tools.name: run_command
startup_tools.description: Start a fresh /bin/sh in a PTY. cwd applies only to this call, relative to the workspace. Merged output and exit_code stay on disk; a running report is a handle, not cancellation. ai_callback_delay is seconds (default 3); pattern matches unseen output; max_output_bytes defaults to 16384.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: wait_for_job
startup_tools.description: Wait for a job, including a finished job. Return only unseen output; waiting does not stop execution.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: micro_handoff
startup_tools.description: Checkpoint at a completed micro-goal. Write text with what succeeded, what failed, source locations and next steps. Removes all tool traffic but preserves conversation and this note.

startup_tools.name: keep_tool_results
startup_tools.description: Keep the previous batch of tool results instead of automatic stubbing on supported models. Does not keep results of tools called alongside this call.

startup_tools.name: wait_for_agent_change
startup_tools.description: Wait for owned children to change, exit, ask a question, match output pattern, or stop progressing. Empty agent_ids means all children.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: send_message
startup_tools.description: Send live steering to an owned child (hint when busy, new turn when idle). Return finalized output since cursor.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: wait_for_agent
startup_tools.description: Wait for new finalized child output after cursor, or return when idle. Cursor is local to this child.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: ask_agent
startup_tools.description: Queue a separate question to an owned child and wait for that turn's result.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: get_submission
startup_tools.description: Read an owned child's submitted result, with durable submit.md fallback.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: kill_agent
startup_tools.description: Cancel and remove an owned child immediately, including its jobs and descendants; retain saved results.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: get_sub_agent_status
startup_tools.description: Report an owned child's lifecycle, activity and measured session token usage.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: interrupt_agent
startup_tools.description: End an owned child's turn while keeping the Agent and other jobs alive. mode now cancels the request; after_tool waits for the next tool report.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: spawn_sub_agent
startup_tools.description: Start a full child agent with an isolated data directory. It inherits your model and restrictions; optional model selects another supported model. Children must submit results.

startup_tools.name: join_agents
startup_tools.description: Wait for the listed children to submit; an empty list means all children. Returns early with pending questions: answer using respond_to_parent_message, then join again. A running job report is not completion.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: agents_status
startup_tools.description: List only your owned children and their explicit submission or failure state.

startup_tools.name: shutdown_agent
startup_tools.description: Stop and remove one owned child recursively. Its saved conversation remains for a later spawn with the same ID.

startup_tools.name: send_message_to_parent
startup_tools.description: Ask your parent (or the human for a root agent) a question and wait for a reply. This does not submit your work. If backgrounded, wait_for_job retrieves the reply.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before looking again, default 3; never a job deadline

startup_tools.name: respond_to_parent_message
startup_tools.description: Answer a question sent by one of your children. Omit message_id only when that child has one pending question.

startup_tools.name: submit
startup_tools.description: Finish your task with a result. Rejected while children remain unfinished: join them or shut them down first.

startup_tools.name: load_skill
startup_tools.description: Load an available skill and its dependencies. Appends its instructions to context and enables its tools.

startup_tools.name: unload_skill
startup_tools.description: Mark a loaded skill for removal at the next compaction. Its tools stop now; instructions remain until then.
